title: Audit Kesiapan UI Lokal

architecture.ui_dependencies: fastapi + uvicorn present; no HTML/template framework

risks: SQLite concurrency (no WAL/busy_timeout) -> 'database is locked' when bot + UI write concurrently
API auth missing -> any local process could access/mutate once data endpoints exist
APP_HOST=0.0.0.0 would expose the API publicly without auth
customer data leakage if API not local-only + authenticated
VPS vs local: SQLite is local to process host; a UI on another machine cannot share it directly
pending migration c7c0a1b2c3d4 (safe but will apply on next init_db)

recommended_architecture.backend: FastAPI (existing), endpoints use get_db() + same services as bot
recommended_architecture.ui: local browser pages calling the API
recommended_architecture.vps_vs_local: run API on same host as DB + SSH tunnel/VPN/auth HTTPS, or move to shared PostgreSQL

unverified: Gemini OCR on real photo (key empty)
real SQLite concurrency between bot and UI (no UI yet)
operational customer data not read (only record counts verified)
